title: possible use after free in the zoneinfo module
object: the weak cache returned by PyObject_GetAttrString
lifetime_ender: Py_XDECREF on the line after the lookup, on the assumption that the type held a reference
shape: free and use on adjacent lines
distinguishing: no re-entrancy and no user callback. Every other case here needs something to run between the free and the use; this one has the two on consecutive lines, with a comment explaining why it is safe
live_proof: back-patched into the 3.13 branch after v3.13.7
